name: Kissikátor (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kissikátor: a red shield with a white church and a fleur-de-lis, within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed KISSIKÁTOR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kissikátor arms with wreath and scroll
